item.title: Peacock expands into AI-driven video, mobile-first live sports, and gaming
item.description: Peacock is betting on new AI-powered video experiences, vertical clips, and mobile games to help its growth.

item.title: Before quantum computing arrives, this startup wants enterprises already running on it
item.description: After selling his AI startup to AMD for $665 million, Peter Sarlin is back with QuTwo, a new venture building the infrastructure it believes enterprises will need when quantum computing finally arrives.

item.title: Truecaller now lets you hang up on scammers — on behalf of your family
item.description: Caller identity platform Truecaller recently launched a new feature that lets one person become an admin of a family group, get alerts about fraud calls received by other members, and even end a call on their behalf if they suspect a family member might get scammed. item.title: How to watch Jensen Huang’s Nvidia GTC 2026 keynote
item.description: GTC — which stands for GPU Technology Conference — is Nvidia's flagship annual event, where the chipmaker typically uses the spotlight to announce new products, champion partnerships, and lay out its vision for the future of computing. Huang's keynote will focus on Nvidia's role in the future of computing and AI.

item.title: Sales automation startup Rox AI hits $1.2B valuation, sources say
item.description: Rox, founded in 2024 by the former chief growth officer of New Relic, offers an AI-native alternative to CRM tools.

item.title: Facebook Marketplace now lets Meta AI respond to buyers’ messages
item.description: When buyers inquire about an item’s availability, sellers can use Meta AI to automatically draft replies using information from their listing, such as the description, availability, pickup location, and price.

item.title: Tinder tries to lure people back to online dating with IRL events, virtual speed dating
item.description: Tinder just got a major revamp as it attempts to reengage its user base and attract younger daters. This includes in-person events, AI enhancements, and even virtual speed dating.

item.title: Atlassian follows Block’s footsteps and cuts staff in the name of AI
item.description: Atlassian laid off 10% of its workforce, around 1,600 people, as the company looks to funnel more funds to AI.

item.title: Bumble introduces an AI dating assistant, ‘Bee’
item.description: Bumble's new AI assistant Bee will move the dating app beyond the swipe by matching people based on compatibility and goals.

item.title: A writer is suing Grammarly for turning her and other authors into ‘AI editors’ without consent
item.description: Journalist Julia Angwin is leading a class action lawsuit against Grammarly for violating her privacy and publicity rights.

item.title: Gumloop lands $50M from Benchmark to turn every employee into an AI agent builder
item.description: As companies race to adopt AI, Benchmark general partner Everett Randle believes the key to success lies in empowering every worker with AI superpowers, and Gumloop’s intuitive agent builder is an example of the kind of tool that will unlock that potential.

item.title: Alexa+ gets a new ‘adults only’ personality option that curses but won’t do NSFW content
item.description: The new Sassy style can curse and roast you, but the fun ends there.

item.title: Wonderful raises $150M Series B at $2B valuation
item.description: The funding round, led by Insight Partners, comes just four months after Wonderful raised a $100 million Series A.

item.title: Google is using old news reports and AI to predict flash floods
item.description: A new way to solve data scarcity: Turning qualitative reports into quantitative data with an LLM.

item.title: Google Maps is getting an AI ‘Ask Maps’ feature and upgraded ‘immersive’ navigation
item.description: The tech giant says the "Immersive Navigation" launch is the biggest update to Maps in over a decade.

item.title: AI ‘actor’ Tilly Norwood put out the worst song I’ve ever heard
item.description: This song is an AI actor's rallying cry to other AI actors, urging them to keep going despite the naysayers who doubt their humanity. Literally no one can relate to this.

item.title: Ford’s new AI assistant will help fleet owners know if seatbelts are being used
item.description: Ford Pro AI debuted at Work Truck Week in Indianapolis and is now available to all of its U.S.-based Pro telematics subscribers.

item.title: Zendesk acquires agentic customer service startup Forethought
item.description: Forethought was years ahead of its time and the 2018 winner of TechCrunch Battlefield.

item.title: Netflix may have paid $600 million for Ben Affleck’s AI startup
item.description: This deal could rank as among the streaming giant's largest acquisitions ever.

item.title: Lovable says it added $100M in revenue last month alone, with just 146 employees
item.description: Swedish vibe-coding unicorn Lovable crossed $400 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in February.
